title: Great for my focus, but the tutorials are annoying
body: I’m loving this app, I just wish there was an option to turn off the tutorial. I just want to keep it simple - water my plants and then get back to focussing. It can be frustrating getting held up going through the tutorial steps when new things are available, I would rather check them out at my own pace.
author: gangaroo014

title: Keeps bugging out
body: I do like this app, it’s really cute and helps me to focus but one main problem I get is that the timer bugs out EVERY single time without fail. Specifically at the time 39:59. I don’t know why it does this and every time I have to refresh my app and it passes the loading screen it becomes a blank screen. In the end when it does eventually load (if it does) it says that I’ve left the app for 20 seconds and have to restart my timer. Please get this issue fixed as soon as possible, the app is practically unusable for me at the moment. Would love to be able to use it without issues.
author: Vanoosha

title: Apps good but can’t sync data
body: Hi the app is really good but I can’t seem to sync data to my other iPad and I can’t even install it after deleting once
author: Janicez12345

title: Cute but frustrating
body:
Love the app, super cute plants but gosh clicking the button over and over after a focus session to watch an ad to get x2 rewards is so frustrating. It comes up with the error that the “video is not ready. If problem persists restart the app”. I’ll be clicking for a good few minutes while restarting the app, using data and have been having this issue on many different wifi servers. Please fix the wifi connection with the app it’s very frustrating and the last thing I need when studying.

It would be much more exciting and rewarding if with each level up the plants change a little feature like new branches! 

Otherwise really nice app, love the music realm!!
author: stephmcc109

title: A little gem of an app that more people should know about!
body:
I’m not one for writing reviews but this app is has made a huge difference in my studies. I have ADHD and this works wonders for me to get things done without the distraction of my phone. The ability to grow cute little plant pals is such a reward as well! I tend to focus a lot more on my work and getting things done so I can add to my little collection of virtual buddies <3 

Thank you for developing such an amazing app!! 💕🌿
author: Ms B Bunni

title: Love it
body: Has made my studying so much more productive
author: Georgia&Hunter

title: A game that utilises productivity
body: I love that this productivity app is also a game. It makes focus time feel more rewarding and i love that you can set timersnto utilise the pomodoro techique, too. I am a uni student with a terrible habit of picking up my phone so this app really helps. I have tried others but this is my favorite
author: AerialRose

title: A few improvements to make
body: I like this app, cute and relaxing.  But it would be better if there were a feature that allowed you to go into certain apps like dictionaries and study apps.  Please add this feature in, and it will be wonderful.  Thanks.
author: MayThe26th
